pages.text: Create: Dragons Plus adds new things for a $(l:create_basics/fans)Fan$(/l) to do. Blow air through a catalyst and items in the stream get processed in bulk.

$(bold)Freezing$() (Powder Snow): ice to packed ice to blue ice, magma cream to slime ball, blaze rod to breeze rod.$(br2)$(bold)Ending$() (Dragon Head or Dragon's Breath): cobblestone to end stone, apple to chorus fruit, leather to phantom membrane.

pages.title: Dragon's Breath
pages.text: A real fluid, usable in cauldrons. It turns to End Stone where it meets lava.
$(bold)Coloring$(): Liquid Dye, made by mixing a dye with water, colors items, mobs and armor it touches. Fans blowing through it color items in bulk. Dye meeting lava makes matching concrete.
$(bold)Sanding$() (quicksand) does sandpaper recipes in bulk. $(bold)Enchanting$() (Golden Aercloud) runs Aether Altar recipes and incubates Moa Eggs. See $(l:exploration/dimensions)Dimensions$(/l).

pages.title: Fragile Fluid Tank
pages.text: Breaks on impact and splashes its fluid onto the surroundings. Fluid Hatches let tanks be filled and emptied by hand.
Create Connected has matching fan catalyst blocks. See $(l:home/create_decor)Building with Create$(/l).
